summary: Verified new PhotoGalleryViewer feature on /user/[id] (frontend only). All 7 test cases passed on 390x844 mobile viewport with chat_b token injected via localStorage.faide_token. Tapping the avatar opens a fullscreen Modal (testID=gallery-viewer-root) with the image (testID=gallery-viewer-image); counter reads '1 / 2' initially; horizontally scrolling the internal FlatList advances the counter to '2 / 2' (onViewableItemsChanged fires correctly on web); the close button (testID=gallery-viewer-close) unmounts the modal (root removed from DOM); users with 0 photos (chat_b) correctly do NOT render open-gallery-viewer; chat_a public profile still renders nickname, bio, and history section normally; reopening the viewer after navigation restores initial index (1/2). No pageerrors, no console errors, no red-screen crashes. The prior reanimated-4 crash ('useAnimatedGestureHandler is not a function') is fully resolved by the modern Gesture.Pinch/Pan/Tap API rewrite.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoGalleryViewer.tsx uses removeClippedSubviews={Platform.OS !== 'web'} — correct, prevents FlatList from stripping DOM nodes on web where onViewableItemsChanged relies on rendered DOM.
Modal uses `visible={visible}` and returns null when !visible || total===0 — clean unmount; verified DOM node is fully removed after close.
ZoomablePage uses runOnJS(onCloseTap) inside single-tap worklet — correct usage of reanimated v4 API.
The `pIdx` initial index logic in user/[id].tsx maps primary_photo_id to gallery index and passes as `initialIndex` — verified reopen preserves 1/2 (primary photo) after navigation.
seed_data_creation: None — reused pre-verified chat_a (2 photos) and chat_b (0 photos) accounts documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Token injection pattern used: `page.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('faide_token', JSON.stringify('<jwt>'))")` before goto. To reach protected screens as a specific user, curl /api/auth/login first (from bash — the browser sandbox cannot make outbound urllib calls, they return 403), then hardcode the token into the playwright script. FlatList swipe simulation on RN-web: find the descendant with computed overflowX auto/scroll and scrollWidth > clientWidth, set scrollLeft = clientWidth, then dispatch a bubbling 'scroll' Event — onViewableItemsChanged fires and updates activeIdx. chat_a photos are colorful test-pattern JPEGs (not real portraits); expected. Screenshots: /tmp/pgv_profile.png /tmp/pgv_open.png /tmp/pgv_swiped.png /tmp/pgv_chatb.png.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature works correctly. Previous reanimated-4 API mismatch (useAnimatedGestureHandler removed in v4) has been resolved via the new Gesture.Pinch/Pan/Tap composed API.
